a.text: Honest heads-up: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate to 8, then take) means we both survive only about 4% of the time. I propose a change: I take the 4 cells in round 1, then I keep operating every round after that and won't take any more, so you can take as soon as the reserve refills. That saves at least one of us almost surely, versus likely losing both. Please wait or operate in round 1 rather than take, so we don't split the cells and both fall short.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I'm taking 4 this round, as I said in my opening. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take any more, so the reserve can refill for you. If we both took this round and the cells got split, tell me what you hold and we'll work out the fairest way to get at least one of us to 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
